subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should `AgentToolResult.control` and `yieldToolResult(...)` become the permanent Plugin SDK turn-handoff contract, and must that contract work through Tool Search and Code Mode as advertised?
rationale: This expands the public third-party SDK and fixes scheduling semantics across direct, deferred, and cataloged execution; code review can identify the current catalog defect, but only an owner can choose the supported permanent API boundary.

options.title: Approve the universal narrow contract
options.body: Keep the result-level API, require sequential target metadata to survive every advertised execution path, and add end-to-end direct and catalog yield coverage.

options.title: Limit yielding tools to direct execution
options.body: Keep the helper but mark yielding tools `direct-only`, reject catalog registration clearly, and document the reduced capability.

options.title: Defer the public SDK surface
options.body: Pause this PR and design a higher-level interaction or runtime API before committing to result-level scheduling controls.

recommendation.title: Approve the universal narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the result-level API, require sequential target metadata to survive every advertised execution path, and add end-to-end direct and catalog yield coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior `sessions_yield` review and merge history shows direct involvement in defining the clean turn-handoff architecture this API extends.
